steps.title: Write the protocol
steps.prompt:
Question: {{inputs.question}}. Years: {{inputs.years}}.

Write {{run.dir}}/protocol.md: inclusion and exclusion rules, and the fields to extract from each study (method, sample, findings, limits). Write {{run.dir}}/plan.md with eight search angles aimed at PubMed, Semantic Scholar and arXiv, each on its own line as search: <query>. Do not search yet.

steps.title: Approve the protocol
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/protocol.md and {{run.dir}}/plan.md. Approve to start searching; reject cancels the run.

steps.title: Screen the abstracts
steps.prompt: Screen every fourth source in {{run.dir}}/sources/sources.json starting at position {{index}} (counting from 0) against the rules in {{run.dir}}/protocol.md. Write {{run.dir}}/screen-{{index}}.md: source id, include or exclude, and the rule that decided it.

steps.title: Extract into the evidence table
steps.prompt: For each source marked include in {{run.dir}}/screen-{{index}}.md, read its full text (the saved page in {{run.dir}}/sources/, or the open-access PDF it links to). Extract the fields in {{run.dir}}/protocol.md with a verbatim quote for each. Write {{run.dir}}/evidence-{{index}}.md, one row per study with its source id.

steps.title: Re-check the extractions
steps.prompt: Re-check a random 20% of rows in {{run.dir}}/evidence-*.md against their sources in {{run.dir}}/sources/. Write {{run.dir}}/check.json as a list of findings with severity, title and detail for each wrong or unsupported value. Set the output key findings to that path. Do not edit the evidence files.

steps.title: Write the review by theme
steps.prompt: Write {{run.dir}}/review.md answering {{inputs.question}} by theme, from {{run.dir}}/evidence-*.md only, with the fixes in {{run.dir}}/check.json applied. Every claim carries a verbatim quote in double quotes and its source id in brackets, like [s01]. If {{run.dir}}/cite-check.json exists, fix each failure it lists by editing in place. Set the output key document to the review path and sources to a list of title and url for each cited source.
